parsed.notes: Each row links a protein (Pharos protein id, resolved to its NCBIGene) to a disease (MONDO id, falling back to DOID where mondoid is empty). Predicate gene_associated_with_condition is the most specific gene-disease predicate in Biolink 4.4.3. Knowledge level and agent differ by dtype: text mining is co-occurrence-based (text_mining_agent, statistical_association); TIGA is a computed rank/score from a pipeline; MedlinePlus, UniProtKB keyword and AmyCo are curated assertions by people. The primary source is set to infores:diseases for all rows because the original upstream resource (MedlinePlus, UniProtKB, TIGA, AmyCo) is not separately identified in the table; the dtype column keeps that distinction. Rows lacking mondoid but with did are still mapped. No keep_if threshold is applied, since conf and zscore are kept as edge properties for the reader to filter on.
